title: Verizon Shine grants Buffalo Bills wish | About Verizon
summary: Verizon Shine surprised 98-year-old Buffalo Bills fan Grandma Lorraine with VIP tickets to the new Highmark Stadium after her story went viral.
body_markdown:
## At a glance


-


**A birthday wish comes true:** At 98 years old, lifelong Buffalo Bills fan Grandma Lorraine is headed to the team’s new Highmark Stadium for a VIP game-day experience.


-


**A surprise made possible by Verizon Shine:** Lorraine received tickets to the November 1 Bills game, pregame sideline passes and a jersey signed by quarterback Josh Allen.


-


**A friendship that captured hearts:** What started with videos shared by Lorraine’s neighbor, Michelle DeHond, grew into a viral sensation, inspiring people around the world to help make her dream a reality.


At 98 years young, Grandma Lorraine has spent decades cheering on the Buffalo Bills. From unforgettable victories to heartbreaking losses, her loyalty to the team has never wavered.


But there was one experience still on her bucket list: attending a game at the Bills’ brand-new Highmark Stadium.


Thanks to Verizon Shine, that dream became a reality.


On October 26, Verizon surprised the Spencerport, New York, resident with tickets to the Bills’ November 1 matchup against the Baltimore Ravens, along with pregame sideline passes and a Josh Allen-signed jersey.


The surprise was more than a birthday gift. It was the culmination of a remarkable friendship, a viral social media story and a shared effort to bring joy to one of Bills Mafia’s most devoted fans.


## A lifelong love for the Buffalo Bills


For Grandma Lorraine, being a Bills fan is more than a Sunday tradition. It’s a connection to family, community and decades of memories.


Years ago, her home was a gathering place for football fans. With one of the neighborhood’s few televisions, Lorraine’s five children and neighborhood kids would come together to watch the Bills play.


That passion continues today.


Her home proudly displays her love for the team, from a Bills logo painted on the front lawn to a mobility scooter featuring a number-one Bills fan license plate.


On game days, Lorraine can still be found dressed in her Bills gear, cheering from her favorite chair.


But after years of watching from home, she had one birthday wish.


“All I wanted to do on my bucket list was to sit down and go to the new Buffalo Bills stadium,” Lorraine said.


## A neighbor’s kindness sparks something special


The journey began with Lorraine’s next-door neighbor, Michelle DeHond.


The two have developed a special friendship, with Michelle regularly checking in on Lorraine, helping with daily tasks and sharing moments from their lives on TikTok.


When Michelle began posting videos showcasing Lorraine’s personality and unwavering love for the Bills, people took notice.


One video attracted more than four million views, and soon cards, letters and gifts began arriving from people around the world.


“People just absolutely fell in love with her,” said Michelle Dehond, Lorraine’s neighbor. “The comments, more recently, it was like, she reminds me of my grandma, she’s so sweet, and that just kind of touches my heart.”


Inspired by the overwhelming response, Michelle launched an online fundraiser to help fulfill Lorraine’s dream of attending a Bills game.


That’s when Verizon stepped in.


## Verizon Shine delivers an unforgettable surprise


After discovering Lorraine’s story on social media, Verizon saw an opportunity to turn a longtime fan’s birthday wish into an unforgettable experience through Verizon Shine, part of the company’s loyalty program designed to deliver exclusive rewards, memorable experiences and unexpected moments of joy to its customers.


On October 26, the Verizon team arrived at Lorraine’s home with a surprise worthy of one of Bills Mafia’s biggest fans.


Lorraine was presented with tickets to watch her beloved team take on the Baltimore Ravens at the new Highmark Stadium, pregame sideline access and a jersey personally signed by quarterback Josh Allen.


Paul Hitchcock, a Verizon retail leader in Upstate New York and New England, told WIVB-TV that after the team learned about Lorraine’s story through TikTok, they knew they wanted to do something special for her.


For Lorraine, the excitement was immediate. She told WIVB she could hardly wait for game day to arrive.


And for Michelle, who helped set the entire experience in motion, the surprise was another example of the extraordinary things that can happen when people come together.


What started as a simple act of kindness between neighbors has become a celebration of friendship, community and a shared love of football.


## Creating moments that shine


Grandma Lorraine’s surprise reflects the spirit of Verizon Shine: creating meaningful connections and bringing Verizon customers closer to the experiences they love.


As part of Verizon’s loyalty program, Verizon Shine offers customers access to special rewards, including sporting events, concerts, VIP experiences, exclusive merchandise and daily deals through the My Verizon app.


For Grandma Lorraine, the result is something even more personal: a chance to experience the excitement of Bills football from inside the stadium she’s dreamed of visiting.


And at 98 years young, she has plenty to cheer about.


Learn more about[Verizon Shine](https://www.verizon.com/shop/consumer-guides/verizon-loyalty-program/) and the exclusive experiences available through the My Verizon app.
